nature: OPERATIONAL DEFINITION of a previously underspecified term. It modifies NO frozen rule — not hub membership, not k_hub, not B_SCALE/B_NULL, not the trigger thresholds, not definedness, not any inferential rule.

NAMING_RULE.why: positive_n is RESERVED for the inferential Y-available denominator. They are different quantities with different gates.

DEFINITION.claim: token_A @ left position AND token_B @ right position
an_episode_is_X_POSITIVE_iff_all_four: 1. the token_A source feature at its FROZEN position has availability == AVAILABLE_VALID
3. the token_B source feature at its FROZEN position has availability == AVAILABLE_VALID
NO_Y: no Y-based path or window filter is used

OPTION_CHOSEN.chosen: A — only the two positions the registered claim names
OPTION_CHOSEN.REJECTED: B — additionally requiring all four of M1/M2/M3/M4 to be available
OPTION_CHOSEN.why_rejected: that would introduce an X-side filter that was never part of the claim definition

EXPLICIT_NON_REQUIREMENT: there is NO requirement that all four M1/M2/M3/M4 positions are simultaneously available or valid. Only the two positions the registered claim names matter.

PREDICATE_FORMS.boolean_TRUE_token: AVAILABLE_VALID AND the frozen boolean value == TRUE
PREDICATE_FORMS.categorical_equality_token: AVAILABLE_VALID AND the frozen categorical value == the registered category

NON_VALID_HANDLING.rule: if either required token position is NON_VALID the episode is NOT X-positive
NON_VALID_HANDLING.and_critically: it is NOT converted to FALSE evidence
invariants: a missing row != a negative state

COUNT_IDENTITY: one claim contributes AT MOST ONE positive count per (security_key_v1, session_date) episode
SAME_TOKEN_ON_BOTH_SIDES: evaluated INDEPENDENTLY at the two registered positions
ACCUMULATION: cumulative over the admissible forward evidence window

REPORT_ONLY.PROHIBITION: it MUST NOT become an additional trigger threshold

PRE_REGISTRATION_OBLIGATION: this definition is frozen BEFORE any historical B census is computed. If it fails to reproduce the frozen pre-Y X-support oracle exactly, that is a HARD STOP — the definition may NOT be adjusted to fit.
